# CalculatorFree.io

> Free financial calculators for loans, mortgages, savings, investments, retirement, taxes, and business finance, complemented by selected general-purpose calculators.

Financial calculators are the site's primary focus. The links below are a curated starting point; the calculator directory provides the complete tool selection. Pages include formulas, worked examples, assumptions, and applicable source notes.

Interactive calculations run in the browser and require JavaScript. Default inputs and results are illustrations; estimates depend on the entered values, selected mode, timing, and rounding conventions. Future return and inflation presets are editable assumptions. General financial mathematics is not a jurisdiction-specific tax model; tax and retirement rules apply only to the jurisdictions and years stated on each page. Currency conversion uses a dated bundled reference snapshot or a manually entered rate. Consult the methodology and each tool's scope before interpreting a result.

Navigation links checked: November 4, 2026. This is a selected navigation file, not the full site inventory. Use the sitemap for all canonical pages and the visible page for current assumptions and review dates.

## Start here

- [Financial disclaimer](https://www.calculatorfree.io/disclaimer): Educational use, no personalized financial, investment, tax or legal advice; model limitations, illustrative assumptions, and independent verification.

- [Guides](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/): Browse seven financial topics with featured guides, compact lists and optional local search. All guide links are included in static HTML; worked examples and model analyses link to the relevant calculators.
- [Retirement calculator directory](https://www.calculatorfree.io/retirement-calculators): Retirement income, account rules and financial-independence planning tools.
- [Business finance calculator directory](https://www.calculatorfree.io/business-calculators): Advertising, shipment costs, profitability, liquidity and business financing tools.
- [Tax and income calculator directory](https://www.calculatorfree.io/tax-income-calculators): Supported U.S. tax-year estimates and income conversions; check each model’s jurisdiction and exclusions.

- [Financial calculator directory](https://www.calculatorfree.io/financial-calculator): Browse the site's financial tools and supporting general-purpose calculators.
- [Calculation methodology and sources](https://www.calculatorfree.io/methodology): Validation approach, illustrative defaults, data versions, timing, rounding, and model limitations.
- [Financial glossary](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/): Plain-English financial definitions with formulas, examples, sources, and links to relevant calculators.
- [Canonical sitemap](https://www.calculatorfree.io/sitemap.xml): Complete canonical page inventory; calculator modes share their parent page's canonical URL.

## Mortgage and housing

- [BRRRR Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/brrrr-calculator): Model one USD purchase, rehab, rental and refinance: cash left in the deal, refinance proceeds and rental cash flow. Refinance proceeds are debt, not profit; no repeated-deal simulation.
- [Cash-on-Cash Return Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/cash-on-cash-return-calculator): Calculate annual cash yield or use a first-year rental worksheet; cash flow after debt service differs from NOI and total investment return.
- [House Hacking Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/house-hacking-calculator): Estimate an owner-occupied property’s monthly housing cash budget with rent from other spaces; not a tax return or lender approval.
- [Pay Off Mortgage vs. Invest Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/pay-off-mortgage-vs-invest-calculator): Compare two equal-budget paths over an entered horizon using an assumed investment return; future returns are not guaranteed.
- [Rent vs. Buy Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/rent-vs-buy-calculator): Compare modeled renting and ownership paths under entered costs, appreciation and investment assumptions.
- [HELOC Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/heloc-calculator): Estimate payments under the supported draw and repayment assumptions; not a live lender rate or approval.

- [NOI Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/noi-calculator): Reconcile rental-property operating income and costs before financing and capital expenditure, with monthly or annual entries.

- [Mortgage and housing calculator directory](https://www.calculatorfree.io/real-estate-calculator): Choose buying, insurance, payoff, refinance and rent-versus-buy tools by housing decision.

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/mortgage-calculator): Estimate payments and ownership costs, model extra principal payments, and compare biweekly payments. Monthly mode automatically estimates PMI from original LTV, an assumed credit-score range and loan term using a dated National MI base-rate card; actual quotes can be entered manually. The requested 80% cancellation model uses the lower of purchase price and original appraisal. Biweekly mode excludes PMI and ownership expenses; cash purchases retain ownership-cost estimates without a loan schedule.
- [Mortgage Payoff Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/mortgage-payoff-calculator): Compare repayment strategies using the current balance or original loan details, including extra payments and biweekly payments.

## Loans and debt

- [Debt Snowball Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/debt-snowball-calculator): Plan smallest-balance-first repayment with entered debts and a total monthly payment budget including minimums.
- [Debt Avalanche Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/debt-avalanche-calculator): Plan highest-APR-first repayment with entered debts and a total monthly payment budget including minimums.
- [Multiple Credit Card Payoff Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/multiple-credit-card-payoff-calculator): Model repayment across multiple cards using balances, APRs, minimums and a total monthly budget.

- [Loan and debt calculator directory](https://www.calculatorfree.io/loan-calculators): Choose loan, vehicle financing, credit-card and debt payoff tools by scenario.

- [Loan Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/loan-calculator): Calculate fixed-rate amortized payments, deferred single repayments, or zero-coupon bond present values.
- [Debt Payoff Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/debt-payoff-calculator): Compare highest-interest-first avalanche and smallest-balance-first snowball strategies using entered debts and payments.

## Savings and investments

- [DRIP Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/drip-calculator): Compare dividend reinvestment with retaining cash using the same deposits, fractional shares, payout frequency, separate price/dividend growth and flat dividend tax. No live quotes or sale-tax model.

- [Investment Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/investment-calculator): Project investment balances and contributions under the selected rate and timing assumptions; projections are not forecasts.
- [Covered Call Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/covered-call-calculator): Model a standard stock buy-write payoff at expiry with entered premiums and costs; excludes early assignment and pre-expiry option valuation.

- [Savings and investment calculator directory](https://www.calculatorfree.io/savings-investment-calculators): Choose savings goals, growth projections, investment returns and financial-mathematics tools.

- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/compound-interest-calculator): Opens in Compound Growth for starting money, monthly or annual contributions, compounding and contribution timing. Equivalent Interest Rate conversion remains a separate mode.
- [Savings Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/savings-calculator): Project savings growth, solve the monthly deposit needed for a goal, or estimate time to reach a target.
- [ROI Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/roi-calculator): Calculate total and annualized investment returns using an investment length or two dates.
- [IRR Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/irr-calculator): Estimate annual IRR from modeled periodic cash flows or unequal amounts at successive year ends. Freely chosen calendar transaction dates are handled by Average Return's Dated Cash Flows mode.
- [Average Return Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/average-return-calculator): Compare arithmetic and geometric returns; Dated Cash Flows calculates an annual money-weighted return from real YYYY-MM-DD transaction dates and amounts, showing multiple roots when found.
- [CD Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/cd-calculator): Estimate certificate of deposit maturity value and after-tax interest under entered assumptions.
- [Treasury Bill Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/treasury-bill-calculator)
- [Tax Equivalent Yield Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/tax-equivalent-yield-calculator)
- [CAGR Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/cagr-calculator): Annualize growth between beginning and ending values, or solve for an implied beginning or ending value, without intermediate cash flows.

## Financial mathematics

- [MIRR Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/mirr-calculator): Equal-period signed cash flows with separate effective annual financing and reinvestment assumptions; reports periodic and annualized modified returns.

- [Finance Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/finance-calculator): Solve time-value-of-money variables under the entered payment, rate and timing assumptions.
- [Future Value Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/future-value-calculator): Estimate future value from starting principal and payments under the selected timing and rate.
- [Present Value Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/present-value-calculator): Discount a future amount and modeled payments to a present value.

## Retirement planning

- [Roth Conversion Ladder Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/roth-conversion-ladder-calculator): Track separate five-tax-year conversion cohorts, regular contribution basis, outside-cash tax costs and early-bridge gaps. Fully taxable, single-owner annual model ending by planning age 59; no earnings withdrawals, tax-bracket optimizer or age-59½ transition.

- [Lean FIRE Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/lean-fire-calculator): Build a lean spending budget and estimate the financial-independence target and first modeled savings crossing; deterministic assumptions, not a success probability.
- [Fat FIRE Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/fat-fire-calculator): Build a higher-spending household budget and estimate its financial-independence target under entered assumptions.
- [Barista FIRE Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/barista-fire-calculator): Model a part-time-income bridge to full retirement with entered spending, income dates and investment assumptions; distinct from stopping contributions under Coast FIRE.
- [HSA Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/hsa-calculator): Explore U.S. health savings account contributions and growth within the tool’s stated eligibility, tax-year and projection assumptions.

- [FIRE Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/fire-calculator): Full financial-independence target and first savings crossing, in today’s USD. No withdrawal simulation or probability of success.

- [Coast FIRE Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/coast-fire-calculator): Estimate today’s retirement savings threshold, the first modeled crossing and a stop-and-coast path. All amounts are today’s USD; no pre-retirement withdrawals or probability of success is modeled.
- [How to calculate Coast FIRE](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-coast-fire/): Formula, age and return comparisons, five target-age model cases, and checked couple and same-start-date benefit-gap worksheets. One shared timeline; pensions and Social Security are not calculated.
- [Coast FIRE meaning](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/coast-fire/): Definition, exact real-return formula and a worked savings-threshold example.

- [401(k) Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/401k-calculator): U.S. planning under fixed 2026 contribution and age-based catch-up rules. Limits combine traditional and Roth deferrals; applicable high-earner catch-up must be Roth. The growth projection does not split their tax treatments or project future legal limit changes.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/retirement-calculator): Estimate required savings, periodic saving, monthly withdrawals, or savings longevity under stated assumptions.
- [IRA Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/ira-calculator): Compare U.S. Traditional IRA, Roth IRA and taxable saving under fixed 2026 contribution limits and entered tax assumptions; eligibility is not inferred.
- [Roth IRA Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/roth-ira-calculator): Compare qualified U.S. Roth IRA growth with equivalent after-tax saving in a taxable account using fixed 2026 contribution rules.
- [RMD Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/rmd-calculator): Estimate U.S. required minimum distributions for traditional IRA and other eligible non-Roth owner balances using supported IRS factors. Roth IRA owners, designated Roth plan balances for 2024 onward, inherited accounts and employer-plan deferrals are excluded.
- [Social Security Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/social-security-calculator): Ideal-age planning uses FRA PIA in age-62 dollars, assumed COLA while waiting and after claiming, and a nominal discount rate. Comparison mode uses separately entered nominal claim-date benefit quotes. Earnings records and benefit statements are not retrieved.

## Tax and income

- [Self-Employment Tax Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/self-employment-tax-calculator): Estimate supported U.S. self-employment taxes under the selected year’s rules and entered earnings; not a complete income-tax return.

- [Income Tax Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/tax-calculator): Estimate selected 2025 or 2026 U.S. federal income tax and withholding balance, including entered eligible passive NIIT income, MFS spouse itemization and year-specific AMT adjustments. The 2026 active-QBI minimum requires the stated eligibility; this is not a complete return-preparation engine.
- [Salary Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/salary-calculator): Convert pay frequencies and compare unadjusted pay with holiday- and vacation-adjusted pay.
- [Paycheck Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/paycheck-calculator): Estimate pay using 2026 U.S. federal rules and explicit state/local effective-rate assumptions; this is not a complete state or city tax engine.

## Mortgage decision tools

- [PMI Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/pmi-calculator): Conventional borrower-paid PMI estimates, original/current LTV and separate 80% request, scheduled 78% and midpoint checks; U.S. rules and dated insurer assumptions are stated.
- [Biweekly Mortgage Payment Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/biweekly-mortgage-calculator): Compare 26 credited payments per year, ordinary monthly and equal-budget monthly alternatives; not an exact 14-day calendar model.
- [Discount Points Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/discount-points-calculator): Enter actual loan quotes; compare cash-flow and balance-aware break-even, upfront fees and holding-period borrowing costs.
- [Mortgage Recast Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/mortgage-recast-calculator)

## Business finance

- [ROAS Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/roas-calculator): Calculate actual, break-even and target-margin return on ad spend using entered revenue, advertising costs and pre-ad margins; ROAS alone is not profit.
- [Landed Cost Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/landed-cost-calculator): Allocate entered shipment and import costs to estimate landed cost; not a customs classification or live tariff service.
- [Quick Ratio Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/quick-ratio-calculator): Measure liquidity from quick asset components or by excluding non-quick assets under stated balance-sheet definitions.
- [Current Ratio Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/current-ratio-calculator): Compare current assets with current liabilities using entered totals or asset components; interpretation depends on business context.

- [Margin Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/margin-calculator): Solve profit, revenue, cost, margin, or markup; separate modes estimate stock and foreign-exchange margin requirements.
- [Markup Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/markup-calculator): Calculate selling price or cost and convert between markup on cost and margin on revenue.
- [Break-Even Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/break-even-calculator): Estimate operating break-even under entered cost and pricing assumptions.
- [Depreciation Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/depreciation-calculator): Compare supported depreciation methods and book-value schedules; calculated book value is not a market-price estimate.

## Selected guides and reproducible model analyses

- [Roth conversion ladder guide](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/roth-conversion-ladder/): Four outside-cash/basis cases and a dated bridge chart separate conversion clocks, living costs and conversion taxes.
- [Pay off mortgage or invest](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/pay-off-mortgage-or-invest/): Five equal-budget, ten-year cases include freed-payment reinvestment and nominal/effective rate conventions.
- [Should you reinvest dividends?](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/should-you-reinvest-dividends/): Five scenarios compare shares plus retained cash, including losses and a flat dividend-tax assumption.
- [Cap rate vs. cash-on-cash return](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/cap-rate-vs-cash-on-cash-return/): Definition plus five same-property loan/reserve cases; no duplicate guide URL.



The six model checks below use hypothetical inputs and deterministic calculations, not observed borrower outcomes, market experiments or return forecasts. Each includes assumptions, numerical tables, charts, downloadable CSV and links to reproduce the calculations.

- [Coast FIRE inflation sensitivity](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/coast-fire-inflation-sensitivity/): 15 modeled cases show how nominal return and inflation assumptions change the Coast FIRE threshold.
- [BRRRR refinance and cash-flow analysis](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/brrrr-refinance-cash-flow-analysis/): 12 modeled cases distinguish cash released at refinance from remaining equity, debt service and rental cash flow.
- [ROAS and profit-margin analysis](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/roas-profit-margin-analysis/): 20 modeled cases show why the same advertising return can imply different post-ad contribution results.
- [Debt snowball vs. avalanche](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/debt-snowball-vs-avalanche/): 10 strategy runs across five equal-budget comparisons distinguish first payoff, debt-free timing and interest costs; no claim about behavioral adherence.
- [Biweekly vs. monthly mortgage payments](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/biweekly-vs-monthly-mortgage-payments/): Five rate cases compare standard monthly, biweekly and matched-budget monthly plans. The residual includes payment timing and periodic-rate conventions.
- [Are mortgage points worth it?](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/are-mortgage-points-worth-it/): 12 holding-period and fee cases distinguish cash-flow break-even from interest-and-balance-aware borrowing cost; no tax or opportunity-cost model.

Additional decision guides with five-case model checks, charts, CSV and reproducible inputs:

- [Barista FIRE vs. Coast FIRE](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/barista-fire-vs-coast-fire/): Compare part-time income, portfolio withdrawals and stopping retirement contributions; five income-stop-age cases isolate the bridge cash-flow effect.
- [CD vs. savings account](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/cd-vs-savings-account/): Compare access to cash and certificate-of-deposit constraints; five constant-APY model cases quantify one-year dollar differences.
- [Rent vs. buy a house](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/rent-vs-buy-a-house/): Understand housing costs and horizons; five appreciation cases test a common five-year exit with fixed controls.
- [Roth IRA vs. Traditional IRA](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/roth-ira-vs-traditional-ira/): Five equal-pretax-budget cases compare retirement tax assumptions; eligibility, deductibility and future rules require separate checks.

- [Mortgage recast vs. refinance](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/mortgage-recast-vs-refinance/): Five lump-sum cases compare recast payment relief with retaining the old payment; interest and liquidity are different objectives.
- [Paying off a car loan early](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/pay-off-car-loan-early/): Five extra-payment budgets quantify fixed-rate interest reductions and their cash requirements.
- [How much emergency fund?](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-much-emergency-fund-should-i-have/): Five reserve-month targets distinguish essential expenses, existing cash, funding gaps and deposit timing.
- [Pay off debt or save?](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/should-i-pay-off-debt-or-save/): Five allocations of spare monthly cash quantify debt interest; this is not a terminal-wealth or liquidity valuation.
- [APR vs. interest rate](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/apr-vs-interest-rate/): Five cash-paid fee amounts show why identical loan rates and payments can have different full-term borrowing costs.
- [Is refinancing worth it?](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/is-refinancing-worth-it/): Five new terms separate lower payments from full-lifetime interest and fees; horizons and monthly budgets differ.
- [Margin vs. markup](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/margin-vs-markup/): Five markup assumptions connect unit cost, selling price, gross profit and the different percentage denominators.
- [How to calculate debt snowball](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-debt-snowball/): First-month worksheet plus five one-time-payment timing cases for smallest-balance-first repayment.
- [How to calculate debt avalanche](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-debt-avalanche/): First-month worksheet plus five one-time-payment timing cases for highest-APR-first repayment.

### Calculation guides

- [How to Calculate Your Monthly Mortgage Payment](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-monthly-mortgage-payment/): Separate loan repayment from tax, insurance and HOA costs, with three checked scenarios and a spreadsheet formula.
- [How Compound Interest Works With Monthly Contributions](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/compound-interest-with-monthly-contributions/): Four matched scenarios separate money you contribute from earnings and show the effect of deposit timing.
- [Annualized Return vs. Total Return: How to Calculate and Compare](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/annualized-return-vs-total-return/): The same 50% cumulative gain becomes a different annualized return over one, three or five years.

- [What Is House Hacking? Costs, Rent Offsets & Examples](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/what-is-house-hacking/): Four rent-loss scenarios show when tenant income lowers a housing budget and when the same property costs more than renting.
- [How to Calculate Cash-on-Cash Return: Costs & Examples](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-cash-on-cash-return/): Build the numerator and denominator explicitly, then test loan cost, reserves and lower rent without hiding negative cash flow.
- [How to Calculate Landed Cost: Shipment & Per-Unit Examples](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-landed-cost/): Reconcile itemized and bundled quotes for 500 identical units, then test freight and entered duty amounts before using cost in pricing.

## For writers and bloggers

- [Embed resources](https://www.calculatorfree.io/embed-resources): The maintained list of supported ad-free embeddable calculators, attribution requirements and embedding guidance. Embed support is limited to the listed tools.

Calculator pages provide Share, Cite and Export controls; Embed appears only where supported. Sharing inputs is opt-in. Citations use the canonical calculator URL. Selected tools provide a “For writers & bloggers” snippet kit with methods, illustrative examples, assumptions and limitations. The Embed resources page groups supported widgets by topic and marks tools with a snippet kit. Follow each tool’s attribution and usage terms.

## Financial reference

- [Lean FIRE](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/lean-fire/): Lower-spending full-target concept, not a universal wealth cutoff.
- [Fat FIRE](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/fat-fire/): Higher-spending budget concept and target-sizing limitations.
- [Dividend reinvestment plan](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/dividend-reinvestment-plan/): Shares purchased from dividends, distinct from external deposits.
- [Roth conversion ladder definition](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/roth-conversion-ladder/): Conversion principal, tax cash and model scope.
- [Roth IRA five-year rules](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/roth-ira-five-year-rules/): Separate conversion clocks and qualified-distribution conditions.
- [Covered call](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/covered-call/): Standard buy-write payoff, capped upside and retained stock downside.



- [Compound interest](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/compound-interest/): How interest accumulates on principal and previous interest, with a worked example.
- [Annual percentage rate (APR)](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/apr/): Meaning, conventions, and limitations when comparing borrowing costs.
- [Annual percentage yield (APY)](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/apy/): Effective annual yield and its relationship to compounding assumptions.
- [Inflation](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/inflation/): Price-level changes, purchasing power, and the distinction between historical data and future assumptions.

## Supporting general-purpose calculators

- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/percentage-calculator): Calculate a percentage of a number, percentage change, or one number as a percentage of another.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/scientific-calculator): Evaluate real-number arithmetic, powers, roots, trigonometric functions, logarithms, and factorials.

## Additional focused tools

- [Cap Rate Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/cap-rate-calculator): Calculate annual NOI yield from known income or a rental worksheet; compare values at assumed target rates. Excludes financing and total return.
- [Credit Card Minimum Payment Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/credit-card-minimum-payment-calculator): Estimate a user-defined minimum, changing payoff schedule and extra-payment comparisons. Actual statement rules may differ.

## Property transaction scenarios

- [Seller Financing Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/seller-financing-calculator): Fixed-rate owner-financed monthly payments and explicit final-month balloon settlement; not a contract or legal eligibility assessment.
- [Fix and Flip Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/fix-and-flip-calculator): Pre-tax house flipping profit, cumulative pre-sale cash funding, financing costs and break-even sale price; no appraisal or profit guarantee.

## Stock purchase scenarios

- [Stock Profit Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/stock-profit-calculator): Manual long-position buy/sell profit after fees and unreinvested cash dividends; no live quote or tax calculation.
- [Stock Average Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/stock-average-calculator): Quantity-weighted economic acquisition cost from separate purchase cards; not a tax cost-basis election or advice to average down.

## Publishing and review transparency

- [Publisher identity](https://www.calculatorfree.io/about#publisher): Calculators and guides are attributed to CalculatorFree.io; the brand does not represent an individual professional qualification. AI assistance is disclosed.
- [Authorship and review policy](https://www.calculatorfree.io/methodology#editorial-policy): Distinguishes arithmetic cross-checks, source checks and professional review. No named independent professional reviewer is claimed; dates retain their stated meaning.

## Retirement account and withdrawal guides

- [How Long Will My Retirement Savings Last?](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-long-will-retirement-savings-last/): Estimate retirement savings longevity with fixed monthly withdrawals. Compare returns, spending and final partial payments, and understand inflation and sequence risk.
- [How Does an HSA Work? Contributions, Tax Savings and Growth](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-does-an-hsa-work/): Understand HSA contribution room, employer deposits, tax assumptions and investment growth. Includes 2026 limits, six reproducible cases and medical-spending scenarios.
- [How to Calculate RMD: Balance, IRS Factor and Remaining Withdrawal](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-rmd/): Calculate an owner-account RMD from the prior December 31 balance and IRS factor. Compare ages, credited distributions and deadlines with reproducible examples.
- [How Does 401(k) Matching Work? Formulas and Checked Examples](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-401k-matching-works/): Calculate two-tier 401(k) matching, distinguish match rate from salary band, and understand contribution limits, payroll timing, true-ups and vesting.

## Property operating income, value and financing guides

- [How to Calculate Net Operating Income for a Rental Property](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-net-operating-income/): Calculate property NOI from rent, vacancy and operating expenses. Includes monthly and annual examples, spreadsheet formulas and the difference from financed cash flow.
- [How to Calculate Cap Rate: Formula, NOI and Property Value](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-cap-rate/): Calculate cap rate from annual NOI and property value. Compare prices, estimate value at a target rate, and understand good cap rates, mortgage exclusions and ROI differences.
- [How to Estimate Rental Property Cash Flow: A Worked Budget](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-rental-property-cash-flow/): Estimate rental cash flow after vacancy, operating costs and debt service. Compare five scenarios, negative cash flow and reserve adjustments with a reproducible worksheet.
- [How Are HELOC Payments Calculated? Draw and Repayment Examples](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-are-heloc-payments-calculated/): Calculate interest-only HELOC draw payments and amortizing repayment. Compare rates, terms, annual fees and closing costs using six reproducible scenarios.

## Stock costs and cash-flow return guides

- [How to Calculate Stock Profit: Fees, Dividends and Break-Even](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-stock-profit/): Calculate stock profit and percentage return after trading fees and cash dividends. Includes six checked examples, fractional shares and the break-even sale-price formula.
- [How to Calculate Average Stock Price: Weighted Cost and Adding Shares](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-average-stock-price/): Calculate quantity-weighted stock cost with fees. Compare averaging down, averaging up and fractional purchases without confusing lower unit cost with recovered losses.
- [How to Calculate IRR: Cash-Flow Timing, Excel and Multiple Roots](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-irr/): Calculate IRR from signed cash flows and correct timing. Includes six checked examples, Excel formulas, zero periods, negative returns and a two-IRR case.
- [How to Calculate MIRR: Financing, Reinvestment and Periods](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-mirr/): Calculate modified internal rate of return from outflow present value and inflow terminal value. Includes seven checked cases, quarterly conversion and Excel formulas.

## Home purchase, financing and renovation guides

- [How to Calculate Seller Financing: Payments, Balloon and Maturity](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-seller-financing/): Calculate owner financing installments and the final balloon. Compare amortization, maturity, interest-only and zero-interest notes with six reproducible examples.
- [How to Calculate House-Flipping Profit: Costs, Cash and Break-Even](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-house-flipping-profit/): Estimate fix-and-flip profit after renovation, holding, financing and selling costs. Compare five checked projects, sale delays, losses and cash requirements.
- [How to Calculate PMI and Understand Cancellation Dates](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-pmi-and-cancellation/): Calculate monthly conventional PMI from a quote and compare the 80% request, scheduled 78% termination and midpoint rules. Includes extra-payment scenarios and scope limits.
- [How Much House Can I Afford? Income, Debt and Ownership Costs](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-much-house-can-i-afford/): Estimate a home price from gross-income ratios or a monthly budget. Compare debt, taxes and HOA costs with five reproducible cases, without treating the estimate as approval.

## Additional financial methods and reproducible model examples
- [How to Read Amortization, Loan Payments and Implied Rates](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-read-amortization-and-loan-payments/): A loan schedule separates the installment from interest and principal. A rate solver reverses that calculation; a TVM calculator also requires consistent cash-flow signs and payment frequencies. None of these tools supplies a lender APR disclosure.
- [How to Calculate Debt-to-Income Ratio Without Mixing Income Units](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-debt-to-income-ratio/): DTI divides recurring monthly debt payments by gross monthly income. It is different from a full take-home living budget and does not decide loan approval.
- [Down Payment and Closing Costs: Calculate the Cash Separately](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/down-payment-and-closing-cost-cash/): Cash available for a purchase must cover both the entered down payment and entered closing costs. A down-payment percentage is not the percentage of your cash that goes to the seller.
- [Bond Price, Coupon and Yield: How the Calculation Works](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/bond-price-coupon-and-yield/): A fixed-coupon bond price discounts its scheduled coupons and principal at the entered yield. Coupon rate, current price and yield to maturity are different quantities.
- [How Fund Fees and Advisory Costs Affect Investment Growth](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/mutual-fund-fees-and-investment-costs/): Compare fees on the same contribution and gross-return assumptions. A fee impact includes both deducted charges and growth those dollars no longer earn.
- [Simple vs. Discounted Payback: Reading Recovery Time and NPV](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/simple-and-discounted-payback/): Payback identifies the first recovery of the initial investment within the supplied cash flows. Discounted payback uses discounted cash flows; neither measures all investment risk.
- [Federal Income Tax vs. Paycheck Estimates: What Each Number Means](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/federal-income-tax-vs-paycheck-estimate/): Annual federal liability, payments already made and take-home pay answer different questions. The paycheck tool allocates an annual estimate; it is not an exact payroll withholding worksheet.
- [Hourly to Salary: Work Hours, Paid Time Off and Annual Pay](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/hourly-to-salary-and-paid-time-off/): An hourly-to-annual conversion needs the number of paid work hours. This calculator separates an unadjusted 52-week amount from its holiday-and-vacation adjustment.
- [Marriage Tax Penalty or Bonus: Compare the Same Two People](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/marriage-tax-penalty-or-bonus/): The model compares combined unmarried federal tax with married-filing-jointly tax. A negative penalty represents a bonus in this comparison, not an automatic refund.
- [Federal Estate Tax: Exclusion, Gifts and Deductions in the Estimate](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/federal-estate-tax-exclusion-and-gifts/): The tool uses the 2026 $15 million basic exclusion and entered estate facts. Zero modeled federal tax is not proof that no return, election or state obligation exists.
- [Currency Conversion: Rate Direction, Stored Quotes and Spreads](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/currency-conversion-rate-direction-and-spread/): A conversion needs a quote in the correct direction: units of the target currency per unit of the source currency. Reference snapshots are not live executable quotes.
- [Inflation and Real Return: Separate Prices from Account Growth](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/inflation-and-real-investment-return/): Inflation changes purchasing power. A real investment return divides the nominal growth factor by the inflation factor; subtracting the percentages is only an approximation.
- [College Cost Planning: Future Tuition and Savings at Enrollment](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/college-costs-and-saving-before-enrollment/): A college plan has a pre-enrollment saving period and a multi-year spending period. Future cost inflation, coverage share and investment assumptions should be kept separate.
- [Tax-Inclusive Prices: Sales Tax and VAT Arithmetic Explained](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/tax-inclusive-prices-sales-tax-and-vat/): Tax added to a base price and tax already included in a gross price require different operations. Entered rates illustrate arithmetic, not jurisdictional taxability.
- [Book Depreciation: Straight Line, Declining Balance and Salvage](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/book-depreciation-methods-and-salvage/): A depreciation schedule allocates an entered cost under a selected planning method. It is not an asset-market-value forecast or an automatic U.S. tax depreciation return.
- [Discounts and Sales Commissions: Choose the Right Price Base](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/discounts-and-sales-commission-bases/): A customer discount reduces selling price; a sales commission applies to its specified compensation base. The two tools calculate those pieces separately and do not infer a combined contract.
- [Lease Payment and Residual Value: A Financing-Equation Guide](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/lease-payment-and-residual-value/): This generic lease tool values monthly payments plus an end-of-term residual. It uses a time-value equation, unlike the simplified rent-factor convention in the Auto Lease tool.
- [How to Calculate CAGR from Starting and Ending Values](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/cagr-and-annualized-growth/): CAGR is the constant annual growth rate connecting two positive endpoints. It does not describe the year-by-year path or correctly attribute returns when interim cash flows are ignored.
- [Tax-Equivalent Yield: Break-Even Rate vs. After-Tax Dollars](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/tax-equivalent-yield-and-after-tax-income/): Tax-equivalent yield converts the entered exempt-option income into the taxable yield required to match it under selected marginal-tax assumptions. It is not a risk-adjusted recommendation.
- [Treasury Bill Discount Rate vs. Return on Purchase Cost](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/treasury-bill-discount-vs-investment-yield/): A Treasury bill discount rate uses face value and a 360-day convention. Your holding-period return instead compares the maturity payoff with the actual purchase cost.
- [Current Ratio vs. Quick Ratio: Assets, Liabilities and Working Capital](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/current-ratio-vs-quick-ratio/): Both ratios compare short-term resources with current liabilities, but quick assets exclude items such as inventory and prepayments. Working capital is a dollar difference, not a ratio.
- [Self-Employment Tax: Net Profit, Wages and the 2026 Wage Base](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/self-employment-tax-net-profit-and-wages/): Self-employment tax is separate from federal income tax. The regular method starts with net business profit and applies Social Security and Medicare rules, including wages already using the annual Social Security base.
- [Covered Call at Expiry: Premium, Capped Upside and Stock Risk](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/covered-call-expiry-profit-and-downside/): A covered-call premium provides limited downside offset while the call caps upside above its strike. The tool models a standard buy-write at expiry, not a risk-free income stream.
- [Credit Card Minimum Payments: Why the Payment Can Fall While Debt Persists](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/credit-card-minimum-payment-and-payoff-time/): A percentage-based minimum can shrink as principal falls. A fixed extra payment changes the payoff path, but the estimate is not your issuer’s actual minimum due.

## PMI quote assumptions and cross-site comparisons
- [PMI Calculator](https://www.calculatorfree.io/pmi-calculator): Illustrative dated rate-card assumptions are distinct from actual annual quotes; compare equal loan inputs and the 80% request, original-schedule 78% and final midpoint benchmarks.
- [PMI calculation and cancellation guide](https://www.calculatorfree.io/guides/how-to-calculate-pmi-and-cancellation/): Explains why website estimates differ, with hypothetical 0.38% / 0.40% annual rates on the same original principal.


## Additional financial definitions

- [Health savings account (HSA)](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/health-savings-account/): Federal tax advantages, eligibility boundaries and a simplified income-tax example.
- [BRRRR method](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/brrrr-method/): Acquisition, rehabilitation, renting and refinance cash; borrowed proceeds are not profit.
- [Sequence of returns risk](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/sequence-of-returns-risk/): How return order interacts with withdrawals; constant-return tools do not simulate this risk.
- [Return on ad spend (ROAS)](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/return-on-ad-spend/): Revenue attribution, advertising spend and the distinction from contribution and profit.
- [Landed cost](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/landed-cost/): Shipment cost boundaries, allocation and a per-unit example; no live tariff determination.
- [Cost basis](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/cost-basis/): Purchased shares, acquisition fees, reinvestment lots and the limits of planning averages for tax reporting.


## Property cash flow and retirement withdrawal terms

- [House hacking](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/house-hacking/): Owner-occupied rent offsets and a whole-property housing budget; not a lender income determination.
- [Loan seasoning](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/loan-seasoning/): Existing-loan age and ownership waiting periods are separate, program-specific requirements; the calculators do not test eligibility.
- [Cash-out refinance](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/cash-out-refinance/): Reconcile the new mortgage, payoff, deducted costs and net cash; distinguish borrowing from profit.
- [Withdrawal rate, SWR and the 4% rule](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/withdrawal-rate/): Initial-balance inflation adjustments differ from a percentage of current balance, lifespan depletion and required minimum distributions.


## Property assumptions and dividend income

- [After-repair value (ARV)](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/after-repair-value/): Completed-condition value is an assumption, not renovation cost, an appraisal or approved refinance funding.
- [Vacancy rate](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/vacancy-rate/): Unit-count and unit-time measures differ from revenue-loss allowances; distinguish market statistics from property forecasts.
- [Capital expenditure (CapEx)](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/capital-expenditure/): Separate operating income, actual capital spending, reserves and tax treatment.
- [Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR)](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/debt-service-coverage-ratio/): Numerator and debt-service definitions matter; simple NOI/P&I coverage is not a lender approval result.
- [Dividend yield](https://www.calculatorfree.io/glossary/dividend-yield/): Annual dividends divided by share price; distinguish income yield from growth and total return.


## Interpreting references

Selected tax, retirement, mortgage/PMI and Coast FIRE pages now state what each reference supports and where it stops. Rule/data sources, mathematical methods, background reading and the site’s own validation are distinct. Source-use annotation dates do not refresh historical data or calculation-check dates; editable returns and inflation are not forecasts endorsed by cited organizations. See [reference-use policy](https://www.calculatorfree.io/methodology#source-use-policy).


## Additional reference-use annotations

The property-investing, debt-strategy, installment-loan and business-finance pages in the second reference pass distinguish mathematical definitions from regulatory context, third-party examples and the publisher’s own source code. Monthly debt projections are not issuer daily-interest statements; rental coverage is not automatically qualifying DSCR; advertising attribution and landed-cost examples do not supply live campaign outcomes or tariff quotes. Source-use dates remain separate from data editions and calculation checks.

## Investment and retirement reference-use annotations
- Selected investment, savings, FIRE, pension and Social Security pages now identify the purpose and scope of each reference, separately from calculation-check and source-edition dates.
- Purchase averages are not automatically eligible tax-lot basis; dividend reinvestment can remain taxable. Annual fee timing, constant returns and flat tax inputs are model assumptions.
- Social Security comparisons start with an entered benefit; they do not retrieve an earnings record or issue an official SSA award. Annuity/pension cash-flow estimates are not insurer quotes or plan eligibility decisions.
- Treasury bill discount yield, purchase-price yield and deposit APY use different conventions. References do not supply live product rates or guarantee retirement outcomes.

## Remaining finance references and scope
- Remaining financial calculator pages and associated guides/glossary entries now identify each reference’s purpose and limits. Publisher methodology is distinguished from external methods, rules, product context and historical data.
- FHA historical premium examples are not current rate tables; VA fee references do not verify entitlement or exemptions. Recast eligibility and biweekly-payment posting depend on actual servicer terms.
- Book depreciation is separate from tax depreciation. UK/EU VAT examples are jurisdiction-specific. Stored Frankfurter reference rates are dated snapshots, not live executable quotes; deposit insurance depends on account and institution facts.
- Original calculation-check and source-edition dates remain separate from reference-use annotation dates. These annotations do not certify complete legal compliance, tax liability, underwriting or investment outcomes.
